confirmedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: coloradoClarityDetailXml via civic_etl.native and etl/state-configs/co.json for county President rows and county President-versus-CU-Regent review rows
confirmedArtifacts.timestampBasis: detail.xml Timestamp 11/25/2025 1:45:46 PM MST; ElectionName 2024 General; ElectionDate 11/5/2024.
confirmedArtifacts.reportingGrain: county candidate totals with precinct participation counts; no per-precinct candidate result rows were observed in the statewide detail.xml inspected from this endpoint
caveats: Endpoint is official and machine-readable, and the ZIP is now committed as the active CO county result/review source.
The loaded Clarity candidate rows sum to 3,190,873 county votes, 1,872 below the prior Abstract/certified-total lead of 3,192,745; do not allocate that gap by county without an official source.
The statewide detail XML exposes county candidate totals and precinct participation counts, not per-precinct candidate totals.

Clarity ElectionVoterTurnout remains a reconciliation lead: its ballotsCast total is 35 below the Historical Election Data Total Ballots Cast value, and its totalVoters field is not the active registered-voter denominator.

confirmedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Colorado Historical Election Data 2024 General Voting Statistics CSV
confirmedArtifacts.reportingGrain: county totals from 2024 General Voting Statistics, election_id 159, blank vote_channel rows
caveats: The export is official Colorado Secretary of State Historical Election Data and includes county and precinct voter-statistics rows; this pass normalizes county rows only.
Total Voters equals Active Voters plus Inactive Voters in all 64 counties and equals the former EAC registered-voter denominator statewide.
Total Ballots Cast is election-level turnout, not presidential contest votes.
Total Ballots Cast is 401 above EAC fallback and 35 above the Clarity ElectionVoterTurnout ballotsCast lead; retain this reconciliation caveat.

confirmedArtifacts.sourceTitle: EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Colorado jurisdiction turnout benchmark
caveats: EAC rows are retained as official benchmark context after the Colorado Historical Election Data voter-statistics export replaced active turnout.
The Historical Election Data export reports the same 4,583,280 registered/Total Voters denominator and 401 more Total Ballots Cast than EAC.
County geometry supports county map joins only; precinct or local reporting-unit geometry/crosswalks are not loaded.
Equipment rows are administration context only; they are not vote, turnout, audit, incident, or proof-of-uniform-precinct-equipment rows.

sourceFindings.finding: The official Clarity detail XML endpoint is committed and parsed for 64 county Presidential Electors rows. Loaded candidate rows reconcile to 3,190,873 county votes: 1,728,159 Harris, 1,377,441 Trump, and 85,273 other loaded candidate votes.
sourceFindings.blocker: The prior Abstract/certified-total lead is 3,192,745 votes, leaving a 1,872-vote gap not allocated by county in the loaded Clarity candidate rows. No per-precinct candidate result rows were observed.

sourceFindings.finding: Colorado had no 2024 U.S. Senate race. The official statewide CU Regent at-large contest is loaded at county grain and paired with county President rows for review context.
sourceFindings.blocker: Subcounty review remains blocked by missing per-precinct candidate rows and matching geometry/crosswalks.

sourceFindings.finding: The official Historical Election Data voter-statistics CSV reports 64 county 2024 General rows with 3,241,155 Total Ballots Cast and 4,583,280 Total Voters. Total Voters equals Active Voters plus Inactive Voters in every county and matches the former EAC registered-voter denominator statewide.
sourceFindings.blocker: No turnout replacement blocker remains for county-grain 2024 registration/turnout. Retain the reconciliation caveat that Total Ballots Cast is 401 above EAC fallback and 35 above the Clarity ElectionVoterTurnout ballotsCast lead; precinct voter-stat rows were collected in the raw export but not normalized for active turnout.

sourceFindings.finding: Official Colorado Historical Election Data contest exports are retained and normalized to 192 county presidential baseline rows: 64 each for 2012, 2016, and 2020.
sourceFindings.blocker: No historical county-baseline blocker remains for 2012, 2016, or 2020.

sourceFindings.finding: County geometry is present in data/co-counties.geojson.
sourceFindings.blocker: No official statewide precinct boundary geometry, precinct result crosswalk, or Clarity precinct-name crosswalk is loaded.

sourceFindings.finding: Colorado is a risk-limiting-audit state and county/SOS request paths exist for audit, CVR availability, recount, correction, incident, and litigation records.
sourceFindings.blocker: No normalized 2024 audit selection/outcome, CVR availability, recount, incident, correction, litigation, custody, tabulator-log, or ballot-manifest rows are loaded.

recommendedNextSteps: Collect an official write-in-inclusive Abstract artifact or source note that allocates the 1,872 presidential-vote gap before representing CO county rows as complete certified totals.

If advisory accuracy below county level is required, request official county detail reports, precinct-level SOV exports, CVR-derived precinct aggregates, or a precinct/result crosswalk from Colorado SOS or county election offices.

Keep Historical Election Data turnout active and retain EAC/Clarity reconciliation caveats; normalize precinct voter-stat rows only after matching precinct result rows and geometry/crosswalks are collected.

Collect or request official 2024 risk-limiting audit selection/outcome files, CVR availability statements, recount/correction/incident/litigation records, ballot manifests, and custody/log artifacts before adding normalized administration rows.
remainingRisks: Colorado now has county-level native result, President-versus-Regent review, state-native county turnout, and official 2012/2016/2020 county historical rows, but no precinct/local candidate rows, precinct geometry/crosswalks, audit, CVR, incident, correction, recount, or litigation rows are loaded.
Loaded Clarity presidential county candidate rows are 1,872 votes below the prior Abstract/certified-total lead, likely write-in or abstract-only scope; this remains unallocated and caveated.
County-level President-versus-Regent review is a coarse source-review screen, not precinct scatter-plot coverage.
The current evidence records source availability and data gaps only. It is not evidence of fraud or misconduct.
